source.section: 25.13 Baraja condicional - 32 eventos que pueden alterar el final

exactIdOverlapRows.canonicalPremise: major injury plus successful rehab; return after 7-10 months and outperform expectations for weeks
exactIdOverlapRows.enginePremise: generic MAJOR_COMEBACK_CONTEXT flag with generic A-D choices
exactIdOverlapRows.reason: same ID but engine does not encode canonical producer/gate/scene-specific choices or factual rehab history

exactIdOverlapRows.canonicalPremise: interested club fails medical clearance or requests special conditions
exactIdOverlapRows.enginePremise: LATE_BODY_REDLINE flag with generic A-D choices
exactIdOverlapRows.reason: same ID but missing real interested-club/formal-market and medical-evaluation authority

exactIdOverlapRows.canonicalPremise: retirement announced plus real market emergency; a club asks whether the player would reconsider
exactIdOverlapRows.enginePremise: announced status plus POST_ANNOUNCE_OFFER flag; LISTEN/DECLINE toggle reconsideration flags
exactIdOverlapRows.reason: same ID but narrative flag is not a formal CareerOffer and terminal reversal semantics belong to Agent 9/shared retirement authority

exactIdOverlapRows.canonicalPremise: retirement plus injury/suspension causes career to end without a final on-field match
exactIdOverlapRows.enginePremise: announced status plus daysInStatus >= 60; closes career by elapsed timer
exactIdOverlapRows.reason: same ID but current engine fabricates closure from elapsed time rather than factual sporting unavailability

exactIdOverlapRows.canonicalPremise: actual last match plus plausible goal window; scoring may occur but is never forced
exactIdOverlapRows.enginePremise: LAST_MATCH_WINDOW plus roleScore; TAKE choice writes STORYBOOK_LAST_GOAL and closes career
exactIdOverlapRows.reason: same ID but current choice can manufacture the goal/closure without authoritative match/goal fact

candidateNonIdentityRelation.reason: both concern post-announcement/retirement reconsideration, but IDs and state-machine semantics differ; no alias or migration mapping may be inferred

engineMetadataAudit.finding: canonStatus=verified is not sufficient evidence: CEVT_RET_RECONSIDER is not a canonical Pasada-7 ID, while the two exact-ID terminal rows have semantic/authority mismatches against the canonical definitions

hardRules: Do not treat equal counts 32/32 as semantic reconciliation
Do not fuzzy-match technical extras to canonical IDs by title/theme
Do not preserve technical generic A-D choice shells as canonical behavior
Do not use roleScore, market flags, agentControl, nationalCaps or retirement timers as substitutes for the factual canonical trigger
Do not migrate/alias CEVT_RET_RECONSIDER to CEVT_38_RETIREMENT_REVERSAL without Agent-9/shared-retirement approval and save evidence
Terminal conditional implementation remains outside Agent-8 runtime ownership
